verdict.rationale: Datadog documents custom LLM-as-a-judge evaluators that use an LLM to judge another LLM's outputs. Evaluators can be saved as drafts or published live, can send attached images and audio to the judge, and attach their results to individual spans. Managed evaluators add ready-made checks such as language mismatch and sensitive data. Missing for 10: detail on what can be configured (judge prompt, model/provider choice, scoring schema such as boolean, score or categorical) and any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can score outputs with configurable LLM-as-a-judge evaluators

citations.quote: Custom LLM-as-a-judge evaluators use an LLM to judge the performance of another LLM.
Evaluators can also send the images and audio attached to your spans to the LLM judge.
After you click Save and Publish, the evaluator goes live. Alternatively, you can Save as Draft and edit or enable it later.
Agent Observability associates evaluations with individual spans so you can view the inputs and outputs that led to a specific evaluation.
